clips.title: The story
paras: A raptor has stolen the guards' payroll from the Crossroads tower, leaving the defenders baffled. Gazrog calls for a cull to keep the beasts from striking again.

The Crossroads depends on mercenary and grunt guards to keep trade routes open across the Barrens. Their pay matters to morale and discipline. When silver vanished from the guard tower, leaders expected Centaur raiders or Quilboar scavengers. Instead, a raptor was caught stealing in the dead of night, leaving the settlement stunned and short of coin.

Gazrog does not know why wild beasts would hoard shiny coins, and he has no interest in studying their behavior. The guards are restless without their pay, so he calls for blood and deterrence. He sends hunters to take a dozen raptor heads from across the savannah, hoping to curb the predators' boldness before a full search for the silver begins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower. It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.
The strange thing is... We caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft. And... It was a raptor! Unbelievable!
I don't know what raptors would want with silver. But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!
Hunt raptors in the Barrens. Collect for me their heads!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those heads, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got rid of the raptors!
Thank you, friend. You are an adventurer of worth.
